title: How Do I Get a Government Fertilizer Subsidy for Palay in the Philippines?
metaTitle: Fertilizer Subsidy for Palay: RSBSA, Vouchers and RCEF
metaDescription: How to get a fertilizer subsidy for palay: register in the RSBSA at your MAO, see what DA vouchers and RCEF have covered, and check FPA registration.
excerpt: DA help for rice farmers, a fertilizer subsidy included, usually starts with one step: registering in the RSBSA at your Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO). The DA has given fertilizer discount vouchers to rice farmers in some years, such as the 2022 national program for farmers in the RSBSA and a 2025 round in Central Visayas. Programs change every year and no amount is promised, so ask your MAO what runs this season. Government approved fertilizer means a product registered with the FPA.

heroImage.alt: The sign of the Municipal Agriculture Office in Sison, Pangasinan, the first stop for a fertilizer subsidy

blocks.text: Every peso saved on fertilizer counts, so many palay farmers ask about government help. But aid programs come and go with each year's budget. This guide covers only programs we could confirm on official government pages, with their years, and the doors that stay the same from season to season.

items: **Register in the RSBSA first.** The DA uses this registry to find who may receive its programs, fertilizer included.
**Fertilizer vouchers have run in some years,** such as the DA program for the 2022 wet season and the 2022 to 2023 dry season.
**RCEF now runs until 2031,** with PHP 30 billion a year for seeds, machines, training, credit and soil improvement.
**Ask your MAO every season,** because programs, amounts and rules change.

blocks.text: How do I qualify for a fertilizer subsidy?

Start with the Registry System for Basic Sectors in Agriculture, the RSBSA. It is the government's list of farmers, fisherfolk and farm workers, and it decides who gets its farm programs. Those programs include loans, crop insurance, seeds, fertilizers, farm inputs, technical assistance and soil analysis.

Registration is voluntary, has no fee and lasts a lifetime. It makes you eligible to apply for DA help. But it does not promise you any program or amount.
How to register in the RSBSA
You must be a Filipino citizen, at least 18 years old, and a farmer, farm worker, fisherfolk or agri youth. Then follow these steps.

items.title: Prepare your documents
items.text: Bring a valid government ID with its number. Owners bring proof of the land, such as a title, tax declaration or CLOA. Tenants bring proof of tenancy, and lessees the lease agreement.

items.title: Get the form from your MAO
items.text: Ask the City or Municipal Agriculture Office for the RSBSA enrollment form, and fill it out.

items.title: Submit it and keep the stub
items.text: Hand in the form with your copies. You get a stub with a temporary RSBSA control number and a DA stamp, your proof of registration.

blocks.text: What fertilizer assistance has the DA given rice farmers?
These are the programs we could confirm, with their years. They show how the help has worked, but none of them is a promise for this season.

blocks.text: RCEF itself did not start as a fertilizer program. RA 11203 split its PHP 10 billion a year into machines (50 percent), seeds (30 percent), credit (10 percent) and extension (10 percent). Since RA 12078, part of the bigger fund can go to soil improvement, so ask your MAO what that means in your town.

blocks.title: No amount is guaranteed
blocks.text: Programs, amounts and rules change with each year's budget, and many cover only selected towns. When we checked in October 2026, we could not find national fertilizer voucher rules for 2026. So ask your MAO what runs this season. RSBSA registration is free, so never pay anyone to put you on a list.
What does government approved fertilizer mean?

It means a product registered with the Fertilizer and Pesticide Authority (FPA). The FPA registers fertilizers before they reach the market, and it licenses the businesses that make and sell them.

To check a bag yourself, open the Registered Products page on the FPA website and download the fertilizer list. Match the company, product name, grade and registration number on your bag, and see that the registration has not expired. Our guide to the [Fertilizer and Pesticide Authority](/blog/fertilizer-and-pesticide-authority) walks through it, and [where to buy fertilizer near you](/blog/fertilizer-store-near-me) covers licensed dealers.
What is the right way to fertilize rice?

Good nutrient management follows one rule, Make EAT right: the right Element, Amount and Timing. Base the amount on MOET, the leaf color chart or the Rice Crop Manager Advisory Service, not on habit.

Those tools tell you which nutrient your soil lacks, so a voucher or your own cash goes to the right bag. For the bag plans by growth stage, see the [best fertilizer for palay](/blog/best-fertilizer-for-palay) and [balanced fertilization for rice](/blog/balanced-fertilization-for-rice).
Where can palay farmers get free farm advice?

items: **Your MAO.** It handles RSBSA registration, and the RSBSA FAQ lists technical assistance and soil analysis among the services registered farmers can apply for.
**The Agricultural Training Institute.** It leads the extension part of RCEF, with training programs, farm schools and a training scholarship scheme.
**Its online courses and helpdesk.** The institute's online learning portal has self paced courses on crops, and its Farmers' Contact Center takes calls, texts and emails.
**PhilRice Text Center.** Text your rice questions to 0917 111 7423.

blocks.text: You can also ask an agriculturist online, as our guide to [asking an agriculturist online](/blog/ask-an-agriculturist-online) explains. Bring photos and your records, because a technician can help faster when you show what you applied and when.
How can anee.io help when I ask for assistance?

To be clear, anee.io does not give out aid or apply for programs for you. What it does is keep your farm's records in one place. Each lot carries its crop, variety, size and place in [farm lots](/features/farm-lots). The [cropping calendar](/features/cropping-calendar) dates every fertilizer task, and on Solo Farmer the [expenses report](/features/expenses-report) shows what each season cost.

Save your MAO technician's number in the Contact List, too. When a program asks about your farm, you have the answers ready, and our guide to [farm records for loans and insurance](/blog/farm-records-for-loans-and-insurance) shows more ways to use them.

items.q: Is there a fertilizer subsidy for palay this season?
items.a: It depends on the year and your town. The DA ran fertilizer discount vouchers for the 2022 wet season and the 2022 to 2023 dry season, and DA Central Visayas handed out vouchers in April 2025. Ask your MAO what runs now.

items.q: How much is the DA fertilizer voucher?
items.a: It has differed by program. Under the 2022 national rules, it was PHP 1,131 per hectare for inbred rice and PHP 2,262 for hybrid rice. Later rounds can set other amounts, so check the current rules with your MAO.

items.q: Do I need to own my land to register in the RSBSA?
items.a: No. Owners bring ownership papers, but tenants can bring proof of tenancy and lessees proof of agreement. Farm workers can also register.

Not as one of its original parts, which were machines, seeds, credit and extension. Since RA 12078 was signed in December 2024, part of the fund also covers soil improvement. Ask your MAO what your town receives.

items.q: Who regulates fertilizer in the Philippines?
items.a: The Fertilizer and Pesticide Authority, an agency under the DA. It registers fertilizers and pesticides and licenses the businesses that handle them.
